title: Vintage 1974 Universal Studios Show Schedules Map Union Oil 76 Hollywood Tour
conditionDescription: Single folded sheet. Handwritten date "Aug. 15, 1974" on the back; fold lines, light toning.
descriptionText:
Vintage Universal Studios "Show Schedules" map, Visitors Entertainment Center, Universal City, California - courtesy of the Union Oil Company (76). Dated by hand on the back: Aug. 15, 1974.

- Illustrated map: Universal Amphitheatre, Motion Picture and Television Museum, Radio Star Theatre, Makeup Show, Stage 70, Animal Actors' Training Stage, Children's Playground, Petting Farm, Pony Ride, Stunt Show Area
- Daily show times for the Make-Up Show, Stage 70 closed-circuit TV, Animal Show and the Western Stunt Show
- From the early studio-tour years, before Jaws and the later rides

Condition: single sheet with fold lines and light toning. Handwritten date on the back (see photos).

Please see all photos - they are part of the description.
